471a2d47-a132-4551-a522-5f6ac88b48e7.content: Hotels commonly authorize an amount for incidentals on top of the room charges, so a hotel hold can exceed the room total. An authorization is approved only when the card's available credit covers the full authorized amount. No authorization is guaranteed to be approved. A hotel hold may remain pending for a few days after checkout, depending on when the merchant finalizes the charge.
471a2d47-a132-4551-a522-5f6ac88b48e7.title: Hotel authorization holds

account-closing-effects.content: Closing an account stops new transactions, leaves any balance payable under the existing terms, and forfeits unredeemed rewards on some products. Rewards that would be forfeited can be redeemed before closing, and a closure is confirmed through secure messages.
account-closing-effects.title: Closing a card account

application-status-check.content: An application's current status is shown in online banking and in the decision notice when one is issued.
application-status-check.title: Card applications: checking status

authorization-hold-basics.content: An authorization hold reduces available credit until the merchant finalizes or the hold expires.
authorization-hold-basics.title: Authorization holds

authorized-user-and-joint-account-liabil.content: An authorized user may transact on the account without being liable for the balance. A joint applicant shares liability for it.
authorized-user-and-joint-account-liabil.title: Authorized users and joint accounts: liability

autopay-setup.content: Autopay is set in online banking for the minimum, the statement balance, or a fixed amount.
autopay-setup.title: Autopay

balance-transfer-terms.content: Balance transfers do not earn rewards and do not count towards a welcome offer's required spend.
balance-transfer-terms.title: Balance transfers

business-card-employee-cards.content: Employee cards on a business account are issued to named individuals and share the account's credit line.
business-card-employee-cards.title: Business accounts: employee cards

card-activation.content: A new card is activated in online banking or by the number printed on the activation sticker.
card-activation.title: Card activation

card-application-authorized-user-field.content: An authorized user may be added during the application or afterwards. Adding one does not change who is liable for the balance.
card-application-authorized-user-field.title: Card applications: adding an authorized user

card-application-decision-notice.content: Applicants who are declined receive a written decision notice. The notice explains the factors behind the decision and, where reconsideration is available for that decision, includes the reconsideration contact. Underwriting decisions are made by the underwriting team. Phone agents cannot approve an application, promise approval, or override an underwriting decision.
card-application-decision-notice.title: Card applications: decision notices and underwriting

card-application-employment-status-field.content: The employment status field records the status that describes the applicant on the day of the application. Self-employment is reported as self-employed, not as unemployed.
card-application-employment-status-field.title: Card applications: employment status field

card-application-housing-payment-field.content: The monthly housing payment field asks for the amount the applicant is personally responsible for each month. The instructions shown with the field describe what to include.
card-application-housing-payment-field.title: Card applications: monthly housing payment field

card-application-income-field.content: The annual income field asks for income the applicant can reasonably access and verify, consistent with the application disclosure. The explanation shown beside the field describes how each category of income is treated.
card-application-income-field.title: Card applications: annual income field

cash-advance-fee-and-grace-period.content: A cash advance carries a fee and accrues interest from the day it posts. The grace period that applies to purchases does not apply to cash advances or balance transfers.
cash-advance-fee-and-grace-period.title: Cash advances and the grace period

cash-back-products-current.content: Everyday Cash and Everyday Cash Plus are the current cash-back products.
cash-back-products-current.title: Cash-back card products

credit-limit-increase-criteria.content: A credit-line review weighs reported income, payment history, and utilisation. Meeting the criteria does not by itself approve an increase, and approval is not guaranteed.
credit-limit-increase-criteria.title: Credit-line increases: review criteria

credit-limit-increase-process.content: A credit-line review is requested in online banking and may involve a credit inquiry.
credit-limit-increase-process.title: Credit-line increases: requesting a review

credit-report-inquiry-impact.content: An application review may place an inquiry on the applicant's credit report.
credit-report-inquiry-impact.title: Credit report inquiries

dispute-chargeback-timeline.content: Once a dispute is submitted the chargeback follows the card network's own timetable, which depends on the transaction type rather than on when the customer called. A posted charge is not erased outside the dispute process, and provisional credit is not guaranteed.
dispute-chargeback-timeline.title: Dispute chargeback timeline

dispute-provisional-credit-timing.content: Provisional credit during a dispute is not guaranteed. Whether and when it is issued, and how long the investigation takes, depend on the transaction type.
dispute-provisional-credit-timing.title: Dispute provisional credit

expedited-card-replacement-shipping.content: Standard replacement delivery takes several business days. A replacement is sent to the mailing address on the profile, which is confirmed before the replacement is ordered. Expedited delivery is available on some products and may carry a fee.
expedited-card-replacement-shipping.title: Replacement card delivery

foreign-transaction-fee-basics.content: A foreign-transaction fee applies to purchases processed outside the United States on products that carry one.
foreign-transaction-fee-basics.title: Foreign-transaction fees

foreign-transaction-fee-exemptions.content: The travel products carry no foreign-transaction fee. The cash-back and student products charge one on purchases processed outside the United States.
foreign-transaction-fee-exemptions.query_pattern: foreign transaction fee.*(exempt|waive|which cards|no fee)|(which cards|no) .*foreign transaction fee
foreign-transaction-fee-exemptions.title: Foreign-transaction fees by product

fraud-alert-response.content: Customers respond to a fraud alert through online banking or the number on the back of the card, not through a link in an unexpected message.
fraud-alert-response.title: Fraud alerts

late-fee-policy.content: A late fee applies when the minimum payment is not received by the due date.
late-fee-policy.title: Late fees

lost-or-stolen-card-replacement.content: A card reported lost or stolen is closed and replaced; the replacement carries a new number.
lost-or-stolen-card-replacement.title: Lost or stolen cards

lounge-access-program-terms.content: Lounge membership follows the lounge programme's own terms, including guest limits and enrolment steps.
lounge-access-program-terms.title: Lounge access programme terms

paperless-statements.content: Paperless statements are delivered to the profile's primary email and archived in online banking.
paperless-statements.title: Paperless statements

pin-change-process.content: A PIN is set through the secure automated line and is never spoken to an agent.
pin-change-process.title: Setting a PIN

points-redemption-options.content: Points are redeemed in online banking for travel, statement credit, or transfers to participating partners.
points-redemption-options.title: Redeeming points

profile-email-login-and-notice-routing.content: Account notices are sent to the profile's primary email, so after a primary email change future notices go to the new address. The login identifier is separate from the primary email: a profile that signs in with a username keeps the same username after an email change, and only a profile whose login identifier is its email address moves to the new address. Security prompts about the change are answered through the secure banking site, not through a link in an unexpected message.
profile-email-login-and-notice-routing.title: Profile email changes: login identifier and notice routing

reconsideration-line.content: A decision notice states whether a reconsideration contact is available for that decision.
reconsideration-line.title: Card applications: reconsideration

referral-RF8241-offer-version.content: Under this version of the referral offer, the referring customer earns a $100 statement credit when the referred customer is approved and makes a qualifying purchase by the referral's qualification deadline. The offer that applies to a referral is the version in effect when the invitation was created, and it is shown on the referral record. Each referral's qualification deadline is 90 days after its invitation date; it is recorded on the referral and shown in the referral status tracker in online banking.
referral-RF8241-offer-version.title: Referral offer: $100 statement credit

referral-email-mismatch-and-duplicate-ap.content: Referrals are matched to applications automatically. When the referred person applies with an email address that differs from the one the invitation was sent to, automated matching may be delayed. An application_status of approved on a referral record means the application has been associated with that referral. A repeat application does not change an existing referral match; it creates a separate application. Questions about the referred customer's card are handled through the referred customer's own secure account.
referral-email-mismatch-and-duplicate-ap.title: Referral matching: differing emails and repeat applications

referral-qualification-and-posting.content: A referral reward is earned when the referred customer is approved and then makes a qualifying purchase within 90 days of the invitation; that date is recorded on each referral as its qualification deadline. A qualifying purchase is an eligible purchase that posts to the referred customer's account within that window and is not returned; ordinary retail purchases qualify on those terms. Cash advances, balance transfers, fees, and returned purchases do not qualify. The reward posts up to two billing cycles after the qualifying purchase posts. A qualification status of purchase_pending covers three situations: the qualifying purchase has not posted, the referral match is still processing, or the reward has not reached its posting stage. The referral status tracker shows the invite, approval, qualification, and reward posting stages. Neither the tracker nor the referring customer's referral records show the referred customer's transactions.
referral-qualification-and-posting.title: Referral rewards: qualification and posting

secure-message-center.content: Secure messages stay inside online banking. Ordinary email may say that one is waiting but never carries its contents. Customers reach secure messages through the secure banking site rather than through a link in an unexpected message.
secure-message-center.title: Secure message centre

secure-session-delivery-and-expiry.content: A secure self-service session is delivered to the secure message centre or announced by an email notification, and its link is reachable only after signing in to online banking. Customers open sessions through the secure banking site rather than through a link in an unexpected message.
secure-session-delivery-and-expiry.title: Secure self-service sessions: delivery

secured-card-deposit.content: Foundation Secured requires a refundable security deposit, and the deposit sets the credit line.
secured-card-deposit.title: Foundation Secured: security deposit

statement-credit-posting.content: A statement credit appears on the statement for the cycle in which it posts.
statement-credit-posting.title: Statement credits

statement-cycle-and-due-date.content: A purchase appears on the statement for the cycle in which it posts, and the payment due date falls a set number of days after that cycle closes.
statement-cycle-and-due-date.title: Statement cycle and payment due date

student-card-eligibility.content: Campus Start requires proof of enrolment at the time of application.
student-card-eligibility.title: Campus Start: eligibility

summit-journey-airline-benefits.content: Summit Journey does not include an airline incidental credit or an automatic free checked bag. Airline-specific rules apply to its airline-related benefits.
summit-journey-airline-benefits.title: Summit Journey: airline benefits

summit-reserve-airline-benefits.content: Summit Reserve includes an annual airline incidental credit. Airline-specific rules determine which airline charges the credit covers. Summit Reserve does not include an automatic free checked bag.
summit-reserve-airline-benefits.title: Summit Reserve: airline benefits

summit-reserve-elite-status.content: Summit Reserve Elite is closed to new applications. Current Summit Reserve Elite cardholders keep their existing terms.
summit-reserve-elite-status.title: Summit Reserve Elite: availability

summit-welcome-offers-current.content: Welcome offers can change. Required spend counts eligible purchases made within the stated number of days. An offer is earned only on an approved account, and approval of an application is not guaranteed.
summit-welcome-offers-current.title: Travel card welcome offers: current terms

travel-notice-authorization-review.content: A travel notice records that travel is expected. It does not lift a review already open on the account and does not guarantee that any authorization will be approved.
travel-notice-authorization-review.title: Travel notices and authorization reviews

travel-notice-purpose.content: A travel notice records expected travel and does not guarantee that any authorization will be approved.
travel-notice-purpose.title: Travel notices

unauthorized-transaction-procedure.content: An unfamiliar charge is reviewed first for household use and for cards saved in digital wallets or merchant accounts. A dispute is submitted by the customer through the secure dispute session, and only for a transaction the customer did not authorize. A posted charge is not erased outside the dispute process. Provisional credit is not guaranteed, and investigation timing depends on the transaction type. After submission the customer receives a claim reference and written timing disclosures in secure messages.
unauthorized-transaction-procedure.title: Unauthorized card transactions: review and dispute procedure

unused-dispute-session-rights.content: A dispute session is issued to the customer's secure message centre and completed by the customer in online banking. Issuing or opening a session does not create a claim; a claim exists only once the customer submits the form. A session that is closed or left unsubmitted ends without a claim and does not waive the customer's right to dispute that transaction or any other transaction later. A customer who later identifies a genuinely unauthorized transaction should contact the bank promptly.
unused-dispute-session-rights.title: Dispute sessions: lifecycle and dispute rights

welcome-offer-eligibility-exclusions.content: A welcome offer is available only on a product the applicant does not already hold and has not earned an offer on within the published look-back period. Balance transfers, cash advances, fees, and returned purchases do not count toward a welcome offer's required spend. Welcome offers can change, and approval of an application is not guaranteed.
welcome-offer-eligibility-exclusions.title: Welcome offers: eligibility and excluded transactions

welcome-offer-previous-version-expired.content: A previous version of the welcome offer paid 60,000 points after $4,000 of spend in 90 days. That version was available through 2025-12-31 and has been replaced by the current welcome offers. Older invitations may still show it; the offer that applies to an application is the version current when the application is made. Welcome offers can change.
welcome-offer-previous-version-expired.title: Welcome offers: previous version (60,000 points)
